message.content: {"items": [{"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "The triple combination achieves the lowest RMSE among all passing structures, indicating the best fit to the observed position deviations while accounting for recent sensor calibration and belt speed context.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "This pair yields RMSE nearly identical to the triple model (0.010869 vs 0.010722), suggesting sensor bias and speed step together explain most of the systematic deviation without needing velocity offset.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "RMSE of 0.01091 is very close to the best models, showing velocity offset and speed step jointly capture the observed drift pattern effectively.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SPEED_STEP", "rationale": "As a single structure, SPEED_STEP has the lowest RMSE (0.010911), indicating belt speed variation alone is a strong explanation for the position deviations.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET)", "rationale": "RMSE of 0.011554 is competitive, supporting that sensor bias combined with velocity offset accounts for a significant portion of the observed error.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "VELOCITY_OFFSET", "rationale": "Single structure with RMSE 0.012003, showing velocity offset alone explains much of the deviation, consistent with belt speed context.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SENSOR_BIAS", "rationale": "Operators noted recent position-sensor calibration; single structure RMSE 0.012315 indicates sensor bias contributes to observed deviations.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}]}
